status: PRIMARY-SOURCE SCOPE AUDIT, not a systematic-review completeness or novelty guarantee

sources.title: Estimating Expected Information Gains for Experimental Designs With Application to the Random Fatigue-Limit Model
sources.evidence: Primary publisher abstract and Crossref; full article not retained
sources.established: Expected Shannon-information design, MCMC/Laplace estimators, RFL follow-up design.
sources.boundary: RFL information gain is established; full algorithm comparison requires full paper.

sources.title: Bayesian optimized collection strategies for fatigue strength testing
sources.evidence: Full primary author preprint v3, 27 pages; journal metadata online2022
sources.established: Bayesian entropy collection for constant-life fatigue strength, staircase/stress-step protocols and experimental tests; model discrimination discussed.
sources.boundary: Constant-life strength and stepped histories differ from virgin CA life; generic entropy/discrimination novelty excluded.

sources.title: Reduction of testing effort for fatigue tests: Application of Bayesian optimal experimental design
sources.evidence: Primary indexed full-text methods plus Crossref; full PDF not retained
sources.established: Bayesian optimal S-N experimental design, parameter-precision utility, Laplace/Monte Carlo and runout factors.
sources.boundary: Bayesian D-optimal S-N testing and runout-aware design are established.

sources.title: Sequential Bayesian Design for Accelerated Life Tests
sources.evidence: Primary NSF public author manuscript,30pages, sections2-4 inspected
sources.established: Sequential Bayesian ALT for polymer composite fatigue, censored likelihood and posterior-averaged use-stress lower-quantile variance criterion.
sources.boundary: Targeting a lower-life quantile or propagating censor likelihood in sequential fatigue design is not novel.

sources.title: Planning and analysis of sequential accelerated life tests under model uncertainty
sources.evidence: Primary official full PDF15pages acquired; English abstract and sections2-3 methods inspected
sources.established: Sequential ALT under Weibull/lognormal candidate distributions, Type-I right-censor likelihood, use-condition quantile prediction variance plus squared misspecification bias, Bayesian model-averaged low-life quantiles.
sources.boundary: Model-aware sequential planning and model-averaged low quantiles alone are not a new mechanism.

sources.title: Adaptive Bayesian planning of fatigue tests for S-N curves using posterior uncertainty
sources.evidence: Primary indexed methods and Crossref; Elsevier metadata OA1 but normal FULL API request401; no full body retained
sources.established: Posterior-uncertainty stress planning; stress-dependent variance shrinkage; sequential observations sampled from empirical within-stress reservoir with no unobserved outcomes given to selector.
sources.boundary: Heteroscedastic posterior planning and retrospective observation reservoirs are current prior art; do not assert censoring absence without full method audit.

sources.title: Gaussian process regression for survival data with competing risks
sources.established: GP survival/event-time regression with censoring and truncation.
sources.boundary: Censored GP/AFT prediction is established; our implementation is a new comparator, not a novel GP-survival method.

sources.title: Gaussian processes with monotonicity information
sources.established: Virtual derivative information and approximate GP inference for monotonicity.
sources.boundary: A decreasing fitted mean alone does not establish decreasing predictive lower quantiles; our diagnostic is not a global theorem.

sources.title: Survival Regression with Proper Scoring Rules and Monotonic Neural Networks
sources.established: Proper right-censored likelihood scoring under specified assumptions, with a monotone survival-network method.
sources.boundary: Use proper predictive event density/survival score; do not indiscriminately claim all Brier/IBS variants are improper.

sources.title: Conformalized survival analysis
sources.established: Marginal lower prediction bounds under stated exchangeability/type-I censoring conditions; extensions under conditional independence.
sources.boundary: Often requires censoring times for failures and separate calibration; cannot directly confer arbitrary-source or R90C90 guarantees here.

sources.title: Conformalized Survival Analysis for General Right-Censored Data
sources.established: Conformal survival methods for general right-censored observations rather than only known censor time for all units.
sources.boundary: General-right-censor calibration exists; exchangeability and censoring assumptions still need audit before use.

sources.title: Machine learning for fatigue life prediction of additively manufactured alloys: Quantifying predictive gain over physics baselines
sources.evidence: Primary indexed preview only; prior local official-access closure retained; cover issue2027 not online date
sources.established: AM fatigue data, physics comparisons and group/material transfer appear in primary preview.
sources.boundary: Do not claim absence of adaptive/censoring details without full methods; group transfer alone is not new.
